name: Lords of the Fallen: Digital Deluxe Edition
storyline: When the tyrannical god Adyr invades the human realm in search of vengeance for his imprisonment, humanity calls upon an unlikely defender: a convicted sinner named Harkyn.
summary: Lords of the Fallen: Digital Deluxe Edition is a digital edition of the 2014 fantasy action role-playing game. It includes the base game and supplementary digital material, including the soundtrack, digital artbook, and map. The game follows Harkyn, a convicted criminal sent to confront the returning Rhogar forces, with gameplay centered on melee combat, equipment builds, magic, and boss encounters.
